plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.
Add SPY to increase broad index exposure to 15%.
Add CRWD to increase exposure to a strong performer.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage.
Expect lower volatility and a more conservative growth profile.
conservative.read: This mode aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly growth. It significantly reduces leverage and focuses on stable assets, accepting lower potential upside for reduced drawdown risk.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to low single digits.
Trim QQQI to 20% to manage concentration.
Buy XLE to add energy sector exposure.
Buy TXN to add quality semiconductor exposure.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
It aims for steady growth with controlled volatility.
balanced.read: This mode targets ~2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding diversified names, aiming for a balance between upside potential and downside protection.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to 6% each.
Trim QQQI to 15% to reduce concentration.
Buy GUSH to add leveraged energy exposure.
Buy LMT to add defense sector exposure.
This plan aggressively pursues growth by increasing leverage and concentration.
Expect higher potential returns but also significantly increased drawdown risk.
aggressive.read: This mode targets ~4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. It increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring scanner setups, accepting substantially higher potential drawdowns and the risks of leveraged ETF decay.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income focus.
Add SPY to 20% for broad index stability.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce exposure to high-beta tech.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income and capital preservation.
It aims for low volatility and reliable distributions, not aggressive growth.
income.read: This mode targets ~1% monthly growth by focusing on income generation and capital preservation. It shifts exposure to income-generating assets and broad indices, minimizing leverage and high-beta single names to reduce volatility and prioritize distributions.
